statements.quote: Our aspiration clearly is to consistently deliver 20%-plus AUM growth
We are hopeful and confident...we will grow back in the next year
Our NIMs expanded by 44 bps sequentially to 8.45% during the quarter
We continue to maintain our guidance on keeping credit costs under check and below 25 bps
We continue to borrow judiciously, raising around Rs. 67.05 billion at a competitive rate of 7.61% for FY26
Our net worth continues to compound, steadily growing at 16% Y-o-Y
We are seeing the network expansion...add like 8 to 10-odd branches in each state
We are shooting for something below 3% opex to AUM ratio

analyst_pushback: Ask for concrete FY27 revenue target
Clarify credit cost guidance in higher risk segments
Question about cost absorption with network expansion
